programmes.d: A chef bets she can turn around the worst restaurant in the city but ends up falling for the owner.
A TV host profiles a local florist’s long-running flower competition in order to land her own show.
Hired to rebrand a radio show, Savannah finds herself falling in love after working with the host.
When Isla’s art unexpectedly sells to Mark, a second commission sees them falling in love.
Sparks fly between a big-city reporter and a ranch owner as she researches the life of a romance novelist.
When Celeste loses her teaching job, she becomes an au-pair for infamous New York tycoon Richard Trapp.
A man kidnaps two girls in Oregon triggering the Amber Alert system throughout many surrounding states.
A woman spends five years trying to get her brainwashed daughter back from a cult.
Vicki goes undercover in a fertility clinic whose unusual success rate is due to the actions of a Swartalfen.
After being sent to Hell, Norman returns to Earth as a demon intent on summoning Astaroth to Earth.
A violent game of cat and mouse between a group of sadistic killers and a young woman trained in the ways of death.
Nikki, a mechanic, falls for publicist Jeremy as they aim to make her the first female car show host.
Landscape architect Evie meets her match with new client Ryan, whose daughters are her biggest fan.
Tiny’s bar will close unless he pays $17K; customers rally to save it. Meanwhile, Jay’s hazing alarms.
Alan handles Women’s Lit as Tiny’s Place plan is approved.
Artist Lea pretends to be the author of a hit romance novel written by Michael, leading to love.
The owner of a struggling market teams up with a celebrity chef to revive each other’s reputations.
